payload.reason: The evidence provides specific modifications made to post-trained BERT, including the addition of adversarial examples and adjustments in training epochs and dropout values.

claims.text: Post-trained BERT (BERT-PT) incorporates adversarial examples to enhance performance in Aspect Extraction (AE) and Aspect Sentiment Classification (ASC).
An ablation study on training epochs and dropout values was conducted to optimize BERT-PT's performance, revealing that certain configurations significantly improve results.
The proposed model with adversarial training outperforms the original post-trained BERT in both AE and ASC tasks.
